parsed.summary: Tracing the four schematic sheets against the specification, the power/ground topology (FAN53610 with EN tied to VIN, MODE to GND, FB to +3V3, correct 2.2 µF/10 µF/1 µH values), the barrel-jack battery-disconnect wiring (matching the in-sheet note and rev-D fix), the Q2/R2 high-side display-power switch driven from U5.31, the keyboard matrix, the microSD and EPD signal maps, and the EPD boost/charge-pump stage (Q1 gate from J1.2, R1 source-sense to J1.3, 10 µH/0.47 Ω and the G1-group 1 µF/6.3 V cap) all agree with the intended design. The only apparent oddities (SPI_CLK/SPI_MOSI on non-native SPI pins, the RJ45 LAN nets, the extra 0.1 µF/16 V decoupling cap) are exactly the items the spec already marks as Inferred / known open items, so no deviation that changes board behaviour is supported by the drawing.
